reason: A is better grounded and more testable: it identifies a crack-sensitive nickel-based alloy, processing limits, relevant high-temperature creep and thermal-cycling tests, and evidence that FSP can suppress liquation cracking in IN738-like systems. Its main weakness is that the cited work chiefly supports FSP as a pre-weld treatment rather than a stand-alone material-restoring repair, so feasibility for filling or closing actual damage remains to be demonstrated.
